Who we are

We're not just a brand.
We're a flock.

Flocking Birds is a growth community for intellectually curious builders navigating career, purpose, faith and life together.

High-growth seasons, career shifts, levelling up, job hunting, are exactly the seasons people go through alone. Most networks stay at the surface. Most book clubs are vibes with a book on the table. We wanted the room where you could be honest about work, and then do something about it.

It started in 2024 with three friends trying to stay in touch. We opened to the public in March 2026. Since then we've grown to over two hundred members across twelve flocks.

Our mission

To create intentional spaces where ambitious people grow through books, conversation, accountability and community.

Our vision

A world where no one has to navigate their growth journey alone.

Our promise

Real books. Real conversations. Real growth. Real community.

What holds us up

Three pillars

These come together or not at all.

01 · Challenge

We do hard things

Hard books, not comfortable ones. Honest conversations. A practical challenge every book. Around three hours a week, to depth rather than surface.

02 · Accountability

We are doers

Peer check-ins and visible progress. The Implementation Showdown is where you say out loud how you actually used the book.

03 · Christ & Community

We do life together, and with God

Career transparency and faith in the same room. Sessions close in prayer. We say this up front so everyone who joins has chosen it.

How it works

One book. Two months. Then we all meet.

Your flock is a small group that meets near you. Every flock runs the same rhythm, so the whole community moves together.

Weeks 1 to 8

Read together

Your flock takes one book over two months, discussing the chapters as you go. Every member gets a turn leading a session.

Throughout

Apply it

One practical challenge tied to the book. Small, real, and built for people with full-time jobs.

End of cycle

Come together

Every flock meets as one community for the book review, the Implementation Showdown, the Hot Take Debate and the awards.

Then

Next book drops

We announce the next title and the cycle restarts. A natural moment to bring someone new in.

Will you keep up? Here's the honest answer.

Two months a book. That is the whole answer. On most titles it works out at twenty or thirty pages a week, which fits around a full-time job and a life. And if you fall behind, come to the discussion anyway. Nobody is marking your homework.

Two months a book · six books a year · the flock picks what comes next.

Join us if

You can commit around three hours a week to depth rather than surface. You value implementation over inspiration. You are comfortable in a room where faith is named out loud.

Not for you if

You want a vibes-only space without the reading. You have a personal sales agenda. You are a chronic excuse maker. No jokers please.
